annotations.title: Forensic case file (evidence pack) for a token, creator group or caller

description: Evidence pack for a flagged pump.fun token, creator wallet group or caller: detectors fired (bundled launch, creator sell-off, wash-like trading, sells after a call, caller sold into own call, recurring launch-and-exit) each with confidence, plain-English on-chain reason and false-positive note; supporting tx signatures with Solscan links, UTC block times and amounts; timeline with price impact; per-wallet P&L; funding/exchange cash-out graph with label sources; SHA-256 integrity hash. Look up by case id (TK-/CL-/KOL-), token mint or wallet; empty = index of cases. On-chain facts only, no claims about intent or identity. Without a trial/paid key: preview (summary, detectors, hash, first transactions).

id.description: Case id, e.g. TK-xxxxxxxxxx, CL-..., KOL-...
